name: Bow Shackle 0.5 t
alloy: Grade 6 high tensile steel, quenched and tempered, hot-dip galvanized
description: The Green Pin® Bow Shackle SC is a bow shackle with a screw collar pin. The screw pin enables quick (dis)assembly which makes the shackle perfect for rigging activities in which assembly and disassembly occur relatively frequently. The Green Pin® Bow Shackle SC can be used for both one-leg and multi-leg systems. Due to the galvanization of the shackle its long-term durability is assured. The shackle's design reduces the wear of (wire) rope as the screw thread is hidden in a chamber. Particularly important for use offshore, the Green Pin® Bow Shackle SC conforms to a wide range of certifications from class societies such as DNV GL. The shackle is available in a range with a working load limit from 0.33 up to 55 ton.
notes: Green Pin Bow Shackle SC (G-4161) GPGHBB06, WLL 0.5 t. Van Beest: MBL equals 6 x WLL (no MBS stated per size), so MBS here is 6 x 0.5 t = 3 t = 29.4 kN. Listed as Spider: '0.5T Green Pin Bow Shackles Galvanized Steel'; Landcruising: 'Van Beest Green Pin Shackle 0.5 to'. Spider Slacklines is a historic seller: not on its shop when the operator checked on 2026-10-11.

name: Oval Carabiner
description: The oval carabiner is a standard piece of slackline equipment used in primitive 1-inch slacklines and in multipliers on advanced rigging setups. SI's oval carabiner is made out of steel and rated to 24 kN making it perfect for primitive 1-inch slacklining.
notes: Listed as 'OVAL CARABINER (Pack of 3)'. Archived 2022: zinc-plated steel, non-locking, straight gate, CE EN 362. Major axis 24 kN closed, 7 kN open, minor axis 8 kN; gate opening 24 mm, inside 89 x 35 mm, outside 109.5 x 57.8 mm, stock 10 mm, 164 g. Price is for a pack of three ($14.99, shown on sale at $4.50).

name: D Shackle 8mm, Stainless
description: Forged from 316 stainless steel with high resistance to corrosion, our D shape is a compact shackle with a big variety of usage in your slackline rig. For example, connecting a narrow surface, such as the end of a pulley, with a large part, like the eye of the rope, becomes possible and easy with the D shackle.
notes: Listed as 'D Shape Shackles Stainless Steel'. From Spider's shop page as saved by the operator on 2026-10-11 (price with 22% VAT added; the page showed it without), size 'D shape Ø8 mm - 26 kN - 0,6 T WLL' (ref. LHSD8). notes: Listed as 'Oval Quick Links - PPE', size 'Oval 10 mm 40 kN' (ref. LQCO1; shop page saved by the operator on 2026-10-11, price with 22% VAT added). Screw opening 12 mm, inner width 21 mm, WLL 12 kN, made in France, individually tested, PPE (EN 362 / EN 12275, UIAA).

name: Twisted Shackle 8mm
description:
Our STAINLESS STEEL TWISTED SHAKLE is a perfect connector for any set-up with a 90° rotation between pieces.
Its high-strength steel is equipped with a shiny and smooth surface, which prevents cuts and damage on webbing and slings.
Our choice "Size 8 mm" includes a CAPTIVE PIN, once unscrewed, the unlosable pin stays blocked inside the shackle body. No more risk of losing or dropoing it.
The "Size 12 mm" has a jaw opening of 25 mm, so it's suitable for soft releases where you wrap your longline around the shackle without damaging it.
notes: Listed as 'Twisted Shackles Stainless Steel', size 'Twisted Ø8 mm - 45 kN - 0,8 T WLL with CAPTIVE PIN'. Technical sheet: jaw 16 mm, MBS 25 kN, WLL 4 kN, 67 g, captive pin, made in Taiwan, no certification, not PPE. The size selector says 45 kN; the technical sheet's 25 kN is used. Slack Inov €9.13 without VAT.
